verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents multiple mechanisms for issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials to agents: agent cards with bounded order-intent allowances, merchant locking, and expiration (crossmint-supp-2, crossmint-supp-8); non-custodial agent wallets with onchain-enforced delegation limited by spend cap, counterparties, and time window, revocable by the user (crossmint-supp-4); and API keys with client-side scoping (crossmint-docs-21). These map directly to 'scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent.' missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of the enforcement claims (only vendor docs), and no explicit documentation of granular API-key scopes/permissions system beyond client-side vs server-side distinction.
